value.title: The Karate Kidder
value.synopsis: Dave, Simon and Theodore are worried for Alvin's safety after Alvin enters a karate contest.

value.title: Playing Favorites
value.synopsis: When Alvin suspects Simon is Dave's favorite, he and Theo challenge Simon to a go-cart race to win Dave's favor.

value.title: Back to Basics
value.synopsis: Everyone thinks Simon has lost his mind after he fails a school test and moves into a tree for some alone time.

value.title: Report Cards
value.synopsis: Alvin worries about his bad report card and does everything he can to intercept the mail before Dave sees it.

value.title: The Cat Sitter
value.synopsis: Theodore is stuck taking care of Miss Croner's cats during a week that Dave wants the boys to focus only on school.

value.title: Addicted
value.synopsis: The Chipettes challenge the Chipmunks to go three hours without their favorite things.

value.title: Spoiler-Itis
value.synopsis: When Alvin is accused of revealing spoilers for everyone's favorite TV show, he agrees not to speak for 24 hours.

value.title: Something Fishy
value.synopsis: When Alvin and Simon think Theodore's pet goldfish has died, they go all out to replace it before he notices.

value.title: Baby Mama Drama
value.synopsis: Alvin and Brittany learn parenting isn't easy when they have to care for a robot baby for a school assignment.

value.title: Ballet Boys
value.synopsis: When Alvin's soccer team struggles, the coach makes the team learn ballet to help with their conditioning.

value.title: Oh Brother Where Art Thou
value.synopsis: When Simon goes missing and nobody seems to remember who he is, Alvin worries that he is losing his mind.

value.title: The Wall
value.synopsis: When some girls at school start debating who is the cutest chipmunk in the girls' bathroom, Alvin wants to be known as the cutest chipmunk.

value.title: The Gift
value.synopsis: It is Dave's birthday and Simon and Theodore have made gifts of Dave, meanwhile, Alvin did not.

value.title: Theo Knows Best
value.synopsis: When Theodore finds a winning lottery ticket, everyone has their own ideas on how the money should be spent.

value.title: The Fugitives
value.synopsis: When the boys accidentally break Dave's new flat-screen TV, they decide to become fugitives on the lam.

value.title: Sherlock Chipmunk
value.synopsis: Jeanette and Eleanor act as Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson when Theodore's teddy bear mysteriously disappears.

value.title: Independence Day
value.synopsis: Tired of taking orders from Dave, the boys move out and decide to build a tree house in the backyard.

value.title: Opposites Attract
value.synopsis: Alvin and Simon become magnetized and inseparable after an invention of Simon's accidentally gets knocked over.

value.title: Temporary Mom
value.synopsis: When the boys get stuck with Miss Miller as a baby sitter, they each take a crack at finding a replacement.

value.title: Tee Fore Two
value.synopsis: Alvin volunteers to caddy a charity golf tournament and surprisingly gets paired up with Miss Smith.
